title: Sam's New Job
text:
Sam is sixteen years old. He lives with his mum and his little sister in a small flat. After school on Saturdays, Sam works in a café. He makes coffee and cleans the tables.

Sam earns money every week, and he saves it for a new bike. His friends often visit the café to talk to him. Sam likes his job, but he also wants more time to study. He is going to ask his boss for fewer hours.

questions.text: What is Sam saving his money for?
Why does Sam want fewer working hours?
options: He needs more time to study
His friends are angry with him

questions.text: How does Sam probably feel about his job?
options: He likes it, but he is also busy
He is bored and tired of everything
He does not care at all

vocabulary.definition: a small place where people buy coffee and snacks
the person who is in charge of your work
to spend time learning about a subject

paragraph_translations: Sam ma szesnaście lat. Mieszka z mamą i młodszą siostrą w małym mieszkaniu. W soboty po szkole Sam pracuje w kawiarni. Robi kawę i sprząta stoliki.

Sam zarabia pieniądze co tydzień i odkłada je na nowy rower. Jego przyjaciele często odwiedzają kawiarnię, żeby z nim porozmawiać. Sam lubi swoją pracę, ale chce też mieć więcej czasu na naukę. Zamierza poprosić szefa o mniej godzin.
